geometry.coordinate_convention: x=image-right, y=front/toward talker, z=up; meters; microphone order is official labels 1..6 minus one
geometry.dimension_evidence: Official image: adjacent columns 10cm, rows 19cm; official text: top-center microphone on back of 1cm frame.
geometry.approximation_notes: Nominal center coordinates reconstructed from official dimensions, not calibrated coordinates; 1cm back offset is an approximation. Omnidirectional freefield plane waves; tablet baffle, frequency response, real noise spatial field and room reverberation are not reproduced. This is custom-data exploration, not exact CHiME replication.

direction_convention: unit vectors point from array toward source; arrival=-relative_position.dot(direction)/c
noise_spatial_model: synthetic_directional_noise; original recording spatial field is not retained

snr_definition.active_frame_expansion: union of all samples covered by active frames

assignment: two noises/source; crossed 0/5 dB by sorted source index
clipping_policy: one scale<=1 shared by both conditions and every speech/noise channel per source
